crossRefs.note: Then I wouldn’t be disappointed, when I consider all of your commandments.
All of your commandments are faithful. They persecute me wrongfully. Help me!
Therefore I consider all of your precepts to be right. I hate every false way.
They were both righteous before God, walking blamelessly in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord.
You are my friends, if you do whatever I command you.
Now these are the commandments, the statutes, and the ordinances, which Yahweh your God commanded to teach you, that…
that you might fear Yahweh your God, to keep all his statutes and his commandments, which I command you—you, your son…
It shall happen, because you listen to these ordinances and keep and do them, that Yahweh your God will keep with you…
Yahweh’s precepts are right, rejoicing the heart. Yahweh’s commandment is pure, enlightening the eyes.
The fear of Yahweh is clean, enduring forever. Yahweh’s ordinances are true, and righteous altogether.
With my lips, I have declared all the ordinances of your mouth.
I have chosen the way of truth. I have set your ordinances before me.
I have not turned away from your ordinances, for you have taught me.
Beware lest you forget Yahweh your God, in not keeping his commandments, his ordinances, and his statutes, which I…

parallels.note: For all his ordinances were before me. I didn’t put away his statutes from me.

translations.web: For all his ordinances were before me. As for his statutes, I didn’t depart from them.
translations.bsb: For all His ordinances are before me; I have not disregarded His statutes.
translations.kjv: For all his judgments were before me: and as for his statutes, I did not depart from them.
translations.asv: For all his ordinances were before me; And as for his statutes, I did not depart from them.
